newsitem.title: USA: Jackpot to buy back shares, suspend dividend.
newsitem.headline: Jackpot to buy back shares, suspend dividend.

text.p: Jackpot Enterprises Inc said its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of 8 cents per share to be distributed on or about Nov. 29, 1996, to stockholders of record on Nov. 15, 1996, and, determined to suspend the payment of quarterly cash dividends in the future.
The company cited its long-term commitment to the gaming machine route business and its desire to maintain flexibility to allocate cash flow to anticipated capital requirements.

The board of directors also authorized the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares of the company's common stock, from time to time, at prevailing market prices. It said it believes these actions will enhance long-term shareholder value.
Jackpot operates one of the largest gaming machine route operations as well as two Casinos in Nevada.
